title: Homogeneity of the diagonal inner product
statement: For every real number $a$ and every real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, the diagonal Gowers inner product of order $k$ satisfies $\operatorname{diag}_k(af)=a^{2^k}\operatorname{diag}_k(f)$.
